change: Room names no longer give away the answer to the first lock, and each play gets its own shuffle.
The kind of report behind each reading is now shown only after you answer the check.
Each prophet's page now has its own search description instead of one shared text.
Calendar exports now carry Moongazer's name, unique event ids and the real export time.
Options are shuffled, and each choice now gets a short note on whether it protects trust.
A note about hadith translations appeared on pages that cite no hadith; it now appears only where hadith are cited.
Surahs that open with the same letters now use a later ayah as the first clue, and the full surah list is folded away.
Lessons now hide the meaning until you ask for it, and the audio label says it plays the full surah.
Removed wording that promised connected events the timeline does not show.
Clarified that an empty search result does not mean an idea is absent from the Quran.
Each app's Sources page now describes only that app, and screen readers no longer run words together across the collection.
